title: Item
description: One request for the principal's attention, on the desk. The contract every surface renders. See docs/item.md.

id.description: Stable id. owner/repo#N when the item is a GitHub issue or PR (the same rule as openloops' Task.id); otherwise itm-<ULID>. Written by the store on submit.

dedupe_key.description: What makes two submissions the same item: a canonical URL, or a hash of session id + question. Only open items are matched.

revision.description: Counts changes to what the principal would have to decide again (ask, decision, action_request, action_class). Written by the store. Annotations and attention do not bump it.

band.description: What kind of need, from the brief's classes.

severity.description: How loudly it may reach the principal; maps to the push ladder.

labels.description: Free tags with a few known ones: hire, escalate, manual-task, likely-done, stale.

title.description: Verb first, at most about 12 words. Same as Task.title.

ask.description: The one imperative line: what the principal is asked to do. Same as Task.ask.

ask_verbatim.description: The requester's own words, clipped, quoted, never paraphrased.

why_now.description: Why this needs the principal now, in at most about 15 words.

said.description: When the underlying claim was made, never restamped: the age of the claim.

basis.description: transcript, registry, ledger heading, issue, upper bound ...

decision.description: The decision requested, same shape and name as openloops' Task.decision. Null when nothing is to be chosen.

recommendation.description: An option id, or a line of text; null when the producer has none.

action_request.description: What will be done on accept (Agent Inbox's action_request). Absent when accepting only acknowledges.

action.description: A verb the acting session understands: merge_pr, admit_primitive, send_message ...

reversibility.description: Written by the gate from the rule table, never by a model.

route.description: The gate's verdict: acted without the principal, shown on the desk, or logged under tolerance.

predicted_objection.description: The representative's note. Written only by the representative.

instead.description: What the principal would likely say instead.

review.description: Findings from managers by concern, in the one opinion schema, by reference.

raised_by.description: Actor id of the producer: a session, a team lead's calling session, the meta-judge, the tick, an adapter.

session.description: The session to resume with the response, if any.

url.description: The item's own page (issue, PR, artifact). Same as Task.url.

links.description: Evidence, artifacts first, the item itself last. Same as Task.links.

tier.description: Where the principal does it. Same vocabulary as Task.tier.

prompt.description: Paste-ready request for a coding session. Same as Task.prompt.

machine.description: Machine the item concerns. Same as Task.machine.

unblocks.description: Ids this item unblocks. Same as Task.unblocks.

source.description: How the item was found (adapter or producer name). Same as Task.source.

due.description: A date that passes without action.

remind_at.description: Set by later; the tick wakes the item at this time.

attention.description: The shown-ledger for this item, per revision.

last_response.description: Copy of the latest response, for snapshots. The response events are the record.

ext.description: Source-specific passthrough, namespaced by source, e.g. ext.openloops.pattern. Nothing equerry reads.

Surface.description: Where a response or change came from. Only tap, push_action, voice and terminal are the principal's surfaces; gate and tick are automated.

ActionClass.description: The consent class, decided by a rule. See docs/consent-table.md.

intent.description: What to do, in the principal's words.

done_when.description: A shell predicate; passing means done.

echo.description: The one line confirmed at capture.
